note: Bokahli is the authority for installed artifacts. modelId is the ONLY public identity. artifactPath is internal and must never cross the API boundary.

primary.note: Loopback only. Never routable. Bokahli is the sole client.

qualification.note: Installed and served as an appliance model. Luak has issued no qualification evidence for this artifact. Bokahli makes NO claim that it is fit for any task class. Q2_K is an aggressive quantisation of a 35B MoE with 8 of 256 experts active per token; extraction faithfulness and citation accuracy are unmeasured.

operational.measurementNote: Context tier chosen from measurement, not from the model's 262144 train context. At 32768 with --parallel 1: 2418 MiB VRAM steady / 2476 MiB peak, 2.03 s cold load, 572.6 tok/s prefill and 52.3 tok/s decode at 24357-token fill. 65536 was also measured stable (3090 MiB, 552.4 prefill, 48.9 decode) but doubles worst-case prefill wall time to 88.5 s. See docs/phase1/measurements/context-tiers.md
